name: COCO (COmparing Continuous Optimizers)
description: A comprehensive platform for benchmarking continuous black-box optimization algorithms. Provides standardized test suites (bbob, bbob-biobj, bbob-largescale, bbob-mixint, bbob-constrained) with automated data collection and visualization tools. Not an LLM benchmark — targets numerical optimization algorithms such as evolutionary strategies, CMA-ES, and Bayesian optimization.
evaluation_method: expected running time (ERT) to reach a target fitness value; function evaluation counts; convergence rate
general_score_metric: expected running time (ERT) normalized by dimension
typical_sota_score: algorithm-dependent; tracked annually at GECCO BBOB workshop
reputation: Standard benchmark framework in evolutionary computation; annual BBOB workshops at GECCO since 2009; widely used in the numerical optimization community
notes: ANSI C core with Python, C/C++, Java, MATLAB, Octave, and Rust interfaces. Not relevant to LLM evaluation — applicable to classic optimization algorithm comparison. Documentation at numbbo.it. Distinct from MS-COCO (image detection benchmark).
